initialState: Each actor starts a fresh browser on the same explicitly blocked primary page. No spontaneous discovery of a dead end is claimed.
pairPolicy: Same initial product, goal, base input and images. Current-candidate actors use concise self-contained role questions and restrict direct candidate evidence to current image or none; historical condition context remains in the existing global availabilityEvidence question. No extra candidate context questions or fields. Legacy questions are byte-unchanged. Evidence restriction and wording are a declared combined intervention. Visual extraction adds a separately tracked input/stage. Rotate actor order per fixture; later trajectories may differ.
retryPolicy: No retries, failed-slot replacement, direct saved-input resends or human data. Stop the next trial on authentication, quota or accounting failure.
